fullDesc: On August 27, 1883 the volcano Krakatoa in Indonesia exploded, creating tsunamis that killed more than 36,000 people. The sound was heard thousands of kilometres away, and the ash caused vivid sunsets around the world.
realFacts: Most deaths were caused by tsunamis
Global temperatures dipped for a few years
Telegraph lines helped spread the news worldwide
A new volcano, Anak Krakatau, later grew in the same spot
